Subject: SSQ follow-up — clarifying evidence map and transient access requests

Marissa,

Thanks again for the SSQ submission last week. A couple of clarifications from our privacy team so we can close out the review:

1) For any PII that may be present in prompt logs, can you point us to a concrete export that shows the retention window, redaction heuristics in action, and an example CSV we can use to validate?

2) We need a short narrative describing transient agent/service credentials (e.g., inference workers, batch jobs) that can access unredacted data, and the audit trail tying those credentials to a KMS key rotation event.

3) Please confirm which subprocessors (and their region) see decrypted PII during runtime vs at rest.

If possible, attach an evidence export and a current dataflow diagram — even a draw.io file is fine. Can we get this by EOD Friday (11/6)?

Best,
Kara Jensen
Head of Security Programs, OptiHealth

Subject: Re: SSQ follow-up — clarifying evidence map and transient access requests

Marissa / Rishi —

I pulled the KMS access logs and a short attestation. Notes: 

- KMS rotations: last rotation 2026-09-14T02:00:00Z; rotation events emit KMS-ID and a rotation signature stored in the key-rotation audit index.
- Transient workers: inference pool nodes obtain ephemeral mTLS certs via our bootstrap CA; cert TTL is 1 hour and each client request logs the mTLS principal. Audit events that link mTLS principal -> KMS-decrypt event are present in our audit index.
- Subprocessors: Batch-storage (CloudStore Inc.) performs encrypted-at-rest storage only. Metric-aggregator service (EdgeMetrics LLC) receives tokenized summaries only (no unredacted prompts). We do, however, have a small logging aggregator (LogStream Partners) that can see unredacted prompts in a short retention buffer (30 minutes) for debugging; those buffers are purged and truncated automatically and have a separate access control list.

I've dropped the extracted attestation PDF into the drive link and attached kms-key-access-matrix.pdf. Laura, can you confirm the retention purge job and link to the ingestion-runbook referenced in the diagram?

-Ben
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
